Rural dialysis network (hard).name: Rural dialysis network (hard)

errors.id: returning multiplies by time to return
errors.text: "returning" multiplies by "time to return" instead of dividing by it, so a longer time to return makes it bigger instead of smaller (and the units do not work out).

errors.id: patients giving up not connected to discouraged patients
errors.text: "patients giving up" drains "waiting list" but is not connected to "discouraged patients", so what leaves "waiting list" vanishes instead of arriving in "discouraged patients".

errors.id: treatments started does not drain waiting list
errors.text: "treatments started" is not connected as an outflow of "waiting list", so "waiting list" never goes down through it and keeps piling up.

errors.id: ordering chairs multiplies by order adjustment time
errors.text: "ordering chairs" multiplies by "order adjustment time" instead of dividing by it, so a longer order adjustment time makes it bigger instead of smaller (and the units do not work out).

distractors: "chairs arriving" should multiply by "build delay" instead of dividing by it.
"desired chairs" should multiply by "target wait" instead of dividing by it.

change.equation: MAX(0, expected_demand + (inventory - desired_inventory) / adjustment_time + supply_line_weight * (desired_supply_line - supply_line) / adjustment_time)

errors.text: "orders" takes the gap the wrong way round ("inventory" minus "desired inventory" instead of "desired inventory" minus "inventory"), so it pushes the opposite way to what is needed.
"deliveries" drains "supply line" but is not connected to "inventory", so what leaves "supply line" vanishes instead of arriving in "inventory".

distractors: "updating expectations" should multiply by "expectation time" instead of dividing by it.
"updating expectations" should use "expected demand" minus "demand" instead of "demand" minus "expected demand".
